title: Sources: General Catalyst is in talks with investors to raise about $10B; it raised $8B in capital in 2024 and had more than $40B in AUM as of last summer (Natasha Mascarenhas/Bloomberg)
summary: Natasha Mascarenhas / Bloomberg: Sources: General Catalyst is in talks with investors to raise about $10B; it raised $8B in capital in 2024 and had more than $40B in AUM as of last summer — General Catalyst, a venture capital firm that has recently transformed into a broader financial services company …
